summary_md: **Navneet ([@navneet_rabdiya](https://x.com/navneet_rabdiya/status/2115709270494966024))** summarizes *Cache Engineering for Agents* ([arXiv 2610.28577](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28577)): instead of summarizing history (which rewrites the prompt prefix and forces re-prefill), it drops stale tool outputs directly from the KV cache, gaining about 1.7 points on average at 27.7% lower cost than summarization.
relevance: KV-cache-aware context management matters for local long-running agents.
